questions.label: When should the chat prompt branch button appear?
questions.help: Recommended: only when the active project folder is a Git repository. This matches the original task list and avoids showing irrelevant controls.
options: Only when the active project folder is a Git repository
Always visible, disabled when no Git repository exists
Only when the FS plugin and IDE plugin are both enabled

questions.label: What should Choose/Create Branch do?
questions.help: Recommended: create or select the project branch for future work, while existing chat thread branch remains read-only. This preserves the original requirement.
options: Create/select project branch for future work; existing chat thread branch remains read-only
Change the current chat thread branch directly
Create a new chat session on the selected branch
Only display branch information; no branch changes

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify nested repositories, worktrees, dirty state, branch creation permissions, or whether Git actions are allowed by default in trusted projects.
